editorial.blurb: Tel Aviv Slices makes the pizza you've been searching for—fresh, flavorful, and never greasy, at a price that won't break the bank.
editorial.insiderTip: Grab a slice or two on your first visit and come back the same day; reviewers love the consistency so much they return immediately. The gluten-free pizza option is available if you need it.
